paletteAndKey.palette: Warm terracotta, olive, mustard, ink, and cream. Gameplay sheets use flat solid colors with no gradients, noise, or paper grain.
paletteAndKey.backgroundKey: #FF00FF exactly; every yaw, FX, and stamp gutter is canonicalized before runtime.
paletteAndKey.runtimeKey: sprites.ts removes only literal #FF00FF, preventing broad purple removal from erasing paint, tires, or lamps.

Cream and ink endurance coupe with a mustard roof band, terracotta rear panel, clear rear glass, road tires, and red lamps.

rowOrder: loaded suspension with brake lamps and steered-wheel pose
carFrameContract.anchor: Every visible car bbox is centered in its 128px cell with a 16px lower key gutter. render.ts compensates that exact 16/128 inset so the tire bbox, rather than the cell edge, lands on the shared road-contact point.
carFrameContract.normalization: All five models and both motion rows use the exact same visible bbox per yaw. This preserves natural yaw foreshortening without model-size or motion-frame jitter.
carFrameContract.timing: Player alternates base/loaded at 10 fps; rivals alternate at 8 fps. Yaw is visual-only steering or relative-heading selection.

wiring.slicing: sprites.ts uses the exact sliceCarGrid 5x2 slicer for cars; compact FX and stamps retain gap slicing.
wiring.player: render.ts draws the player at a 68px canvas width with a bright livery; this is render-only.
wiring.rivals: render.ts keeps shared visual world width 14 and a 92px visual cap for legible perspective-scaled rivals; player and rivals use the same 16/128 tire-contact compensation and no engine values change.
wiring.motion: The renderer removed hover bob and only draws the twin exhaust burst when engine boost is active.
wiring.courses: The panorama at engine circuitIndex is cropped as a horizon-only band behind the Mode-7 playable road, preventing a doubled-road seam.
wiring.physics: No course geometry, tuning, collisions, AI, scoring, or balance values were changed.

validation.gridProbe: Every yaw sheet passes scripts/probe-sprite-grid.py with 5 columns, 2 rows, and a 4px minimum margin. The final report gives identical 108x68, 102x68, 88x68, 102x68, 108x68 bounds for every car and both rows.
validation.fxProbe: fx-road.png passes a 4-by-1 4px-gutter probe; FX and stamp sheets contain no near-magenta violet-family pixels.
validation.playtest: Fresh 8080 local captures covered the countdown grid, straight running, left steering, and right steering at cabinet scale.
